lines.zh: 金叶一摇，整片林子都亮。
lines.en: One shake and the whole grove shines.
My roots pull free with a fistful of soil.
Every step shakes a little gold dust loose.

lines.zh: 今天的林子吵得不对劲。
lines.en: The forest is noisier than it should be.

lines.zh: 我身上镀的金，是树汁变的。
lines.en: The gold on me came from sap.
The trunk moves slowly; the soil gives way fast.

lines.zh: 镀金的树皮，走一步响一声。
lines.en: A step on gilded bark rings once.

lines.zh: 我这把年纪，走路算快了。
lines.en: At my age, this counts as hurrying.
My gilded bark rustles as I walk.
I shake, and gold dust falls.
Branch knocks branch with a clink.
Fallen leaves trail me like attendants.

lines.zh: 我的年轮里，镀着一层金。
lines.en: A layer of gold runs through my rings.
The gold in my rings has thickened again.
Standing still, I'm still a tree.

lines.zh: 有只甲虫在我树皮下过冬。
lines.en: A beetle winters under my bark.
I counted my branches. One is missing.

lines.zh: 阳光穿过金叶，落在土上。
lines.en: Sun through gold leaves falls on the soil.

lines.zh: 这根树杈，是我自己的王座。
lines.en: This limb is a throne of my own.
When I keep still, birds dare to land.

lines.zh: 土底下的根，互相打招呼。
lines.en: My roots greet each other underground.
Dew slides down my gilded bark.
One gold ring takes a hundred years.

lines.zh: 我又想起砍我的那把斧。
lines.en: I remember the axe that cut me.
Gold sheen runs along my bark.
The wind through my leaves speaks for me.

lines.zh: 树荫挪了半尺，一天过了。
lines.en: My shade shifts half a foot. A day is gone.

lines.zh: 金子是从树汁里长出来的。
lines.en: The gold grows out of my sap.

lines.zh: 我站着，就是这片林子的钟。
lines.en: Standing here, I am this forest's clock.
The axe stopped. I'm waiting.

lines.zh: 我这身镀金树皮，斧子砍不动。
lines.en: Gilded bark like this, an axe won't cut it.
Gilded, I feel the weight of every step.

lines.zh: 你抬头看我，脖子累不累。
lines.en: Looking up at me — does your neck ache?

lines.zh: 这身金皮，太阳一照就晃眼。
lines.en: My gold bark dazzles in the sun.
That axe in your hand — I know it.
Not on my roots. It stings.
You are shorter than the last batch.

lines.zh: 镀了金的树皮，太阳下发烫。
lines.en: Gilded bark burns hot in the sun.

lines.zh: 我的树皮镀了金，走起来沉。
lines.en: My gilded bark makes my steps heavy.
One shift of an axe and I know.
Gilded leaves make no sound in wind.

lines.zh: 这片林子的落叶归我扫。
lines.en: The fallen leaves here are mine to sweep.
Sap is running. Sweet sap.
Gently — my rings have gone brittle.

lines.zh: 每被砍一刀，我就多一圈金。
lines.en: Every cut adds a ring of gold.
That gash will take ten years to close.
I am fine. Only shedding gold dust.
Do not cut the same place twice.
My bark is splitting. Hear it?
I am still standing. The roots hold.
Not painful. Just undignified.
The axe dulled. My bark remains.
Tip that sack of soil toward me.
So shiny. I cannot look away.
Put it down, then take three steps back.
Gilded things. I've tasted them.
Set the waterskin down. I will drink myself.

lines.zh: 镀金的叶子晃眼，就一眼。
lines.en: That gilded leaf glitters — just one look.
A sapling? Give it here. I know its mother.
My roots moved first. Not my fault.
Water me and I grow faster.

lines.zh: 我的树皮上镀着一层金。
lines.en: My bark wears a coat of gold.
You bounced off me like a pinecone.

lines.zh: 镀金的地方，撞上去最响。
lines.en: The gilded parts ring loudest.

lines.zh: 我的树皮硬，你的肩膀软。
lines.en: Hard bark, soft shoulder.
Stay back. My gold bark has thorns.
That knocked off three leaves.
I swayed, and the soil swayed with me.
Why rush? Even my rings do not rush.
Back off. I am drawing my roots in.
Bump me if you must. Not the gold.
That branch took me ten years.

lines.zh: 我把最直的那根枝给你。
lines.en: I give you my straightest branch.

lines.zh: 我身上镀的金，是树给的。
lines.en: The gold on me came from the trees.
Two trees can shade a whole sky.
Pollen has settled on your shoulder.
After this rain, we will talk.
Roots twined together do not fear wind.
I bloom slowly, but I bloom long.
Let's twine our roots together.
When you become a tree, I will still stand.
This gilded body clinks when I move.
This stone will hold my roots down.
A fallen leaf, tucked into my rings.
My gilded bark rings when struck.
Bone meal? I will try it at my feet.
I know gold when I see it. It hides badly.
Bury this and a tree comes up.
Whatever falls to the ground is fertilizer.
I will carry it curled in my roots.

lines.zh: 金子做的根，也扎得进土。
lines.en: Golden roots still find the soil.

lines.zh: 这点金光，够我照一整天。
lines.en: This glimmer will light me all day.
One axe ring and I start looking.

lines.zh: 我的蘑菇圈被你踩塌了。
lines.en: You trampled my mushroom ring.
Gilded branches bow me down.
These fallen leaves will cover your feet.
I am slow, but this forest is small.
My roots are already spreading underground.
I'm rare — you're lucky to meet me.
No one has dared cut me in ages.
I have roused the whole forest.

lines.zh: 你踩进来，根须已经收紧了。
lines.en: You stepped in, and my roots have tightened.
Wherever you run, roots lie beneath.
My roots turned that corner before you.
My bark is gilded.
The gold glare shows me the way.

lines.zh: 我的树皮镀了金，闪得远。
lines.en: Gilded bark makes me shine from afar.
Do not circle the trees. They all heed me.
One of my strides is half your day.

lines.zh: 我身上的金子，是叶片镀的。
lines.en: The gold on me was plated by my leaves.

lines.zh: 你往左，我的金枝也往左。
lines.en: You go left, and my gilded branches follow.
You pant louder than my leaves rustle.

lines.zh: 镀金的枝，打在身上更沉。
lines.en: Gilded branches land heavier.

lines.zh: 倒吧，像我砍倒的树那样。
lines.en: Fall, as the trees I cut down fell.
Stand firm and do not cry out.
A gold branch swings down with a hiss.
This blow grew for eighty years.

lines.zh: 我抬一次手，金子都在响。
lines.en: When I raise a hand, the gold rings.
The thorn enters first. The branch follows.
Woodcutter, taste my rings.
Fall, like the ones you felled.
No use hiding. My roots are here.

lines.zh: 镀金的树，长得比别的慢。
lines.en: A gilded tree grows slower than the rest.

lines.zh: 镀金的根，从土里抬起来了。
lines.en: Gilded roots are lifting out of the soil.

lines.zh: 我从土里站起，根还带着泥。
lines.en: I rise from the soil, roots still muddy.
Gilded leaves never fall.

lines.zh: 根从土里一根根抬起来。
lines.en: Root by root, I lift from the soil.

lines.zh: 我的根，盘着一小堆金子。
lines.en: My roots curl around a little gold.

lines.zh: 金色是长出来的，不是刷的。
lines.en: This gold grew on me. It was not painted.
Patina crawls across my bark.

lines.zh: 我这身金皮好像长错地方了。
lines.en: This golden bark seems to have grown wrong.

lines.zh: 我醒了，这片林子醒了吗。
lines.en: I woke up, has the forest?

lines.zh: 林子里多了个会走的影子。
lines.en: The forest has a walking shadow now.
The soil loosened. Time to rise.
My gold bark is softening. Hurry.
Down I go, crushing a patch of grass.
Trees need air too, and this water is deep.
Gold dust everywhere.
An arrow, lodged in my rings.

lines.zh: 镀金的树皮，被刮开一道。
lines.en: A gash in my gilded bark.
I have not tasted rain in a long while.
Lightning chipped off a patch of gold.
No soil below. Nothing to root in.
